verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an autonomous research service, which could plausibly offer batch runs over many topics, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only single-topic runs (one research topic per run, 100 credits per run). The 'Download all samples' link is website marketing material, and 'multiple strategic dimensions' describes analysis inside one report, not bulk operations across items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
